tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: The vibestreak leaderboard of AI-assisted developers, ranked by consistency (active days), commits shipped with an AI co-author, current streak, or tokens. Optionally a date range, one or more AI tools, or only GitHub-verified profiles. Use `you` to include a particular person's rank.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: A developer's public vibestreak profile: current and longest streak, streak level, whether they were active today, totals (active days, commits shipped with AI, messages, tokens), their AI tools, and a text heatmap of recent weeks.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: The profile of the person this connection belongs to (it needs their vibestreak CLI token as `Authorization: Bearer …`), even if their profile is hidden: streak, whether today is done or the streak ends at midnight, the days to their next level, totals and a heatmap.

tools.name: get_today
tools.description: Who on vibestreak has coded with AI today (each in their own timezone), with their streaks, and whose streak ends at midnight unless they code today.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_profile" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: The profile of the person this connection belongs to (it needs their vibestreak CLI token as `Authorization: Bearer …`), even if their profile is hidden: streak…
